import ast, csv, gzip, hashlib, json, math, unittest
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

P=Path('/workspace/jiaoyi-monday-18464')
d=json.loads((P/'analysis.json').read_text())
c=json.loads((P/'capture.json').read_text())
def micros(t): return round(datetime.fromisoformat(t.replace('Z','+00:00')).timestamp()*1e6)
START=micros(c['activity_start']);END=micros(c['activity_end_exclusive'])

class AuditTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cutoff_cash_and_continuity(self):
        self.assertLess(START,END)
        self.assertEqual(START,micros('2026-11-14T05:35:00+08:00'))
        self.assertEqual(END,micros('2026-11-16T07:15:00+08:00'))
        rows=[t for t in d['ledger']if t['in_requested_window']]
        self.assertTrue(all(START<=micros(t['exit_at'])<END for t in rows))
        self.assertEqual(len(rows),len({t['position_id']for t in rows}))
        self.assertFalse(any(t['in_requested_window']for t in d['ledger']if t['prior_partial_followup']))
        self.assertEqual(sum(Decimal(str(t['net_usd']))for t in rows),Decimal(str(d['window_closed_s3_net_usd'])))
        self.assertEqual(round(d['continuity']['prior_post_pr214_cash_usd']+d['window_closed_s3_net_usd'],2),d['cash_evidence']['post_pr214']['total_usd'])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((P/'monitor.json').read_text()),json.loads((P/'monitor-reconciled.json').read_text()))
        self.assertTrue(d['repeat_interval_metrics_recheck']['successful_history_extends_past_cutoff'])

    def test_receipt_hash_ranges_and_coverage(self):
        intervals={}
        for r in d['quote_receipts']:
            raw=gzip.decompress((P/'quotes'/r['filename']).read_bytes())
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),r['sha256'])
            self.assertEqual(raw.count(b'\n'),r['rows'])
            lo,hi=micros(r['window_start']),micros(r['through_exclusive'])
            self.assertLess(lo,hi)
            self.assertTrue(all(lo<=int(x[0])<hi for x in csv.reader(raw.decode().splitlines())))
            self.assertEqual(r['new_broker_requests'],0)
            intervals.setdefault((r['account_id'],r['symbol']),[]).append((lo,hi))
        for key,rr in intervals.items():
            rr.sort();self.assertTrue(all(x[1]<=y[0]for x,y in zip(rr,rr[1:])))
        for t in d['ledger']:
            lo=micros(t['entry_at'])-6_000_000;hi=min(micros(t['exit_at'])+14_400_000_000,micros(c['quote_capture_horizon']))
            for a,b in intervals[(t['account_id'],t['symbol'])]:
                if a<=lo<b:lo=b
            self.assertGreaterEqual(lo,hi)

    def test_arithmetic_and_endpoint_nulls(self):
        for t in d['ledger']:
            self.assertAlmostEqual(t['risk_price'],abs(t['entry_fill']-t['initial_sl']))
            for z in (t['post_close']['max_favourable'],t['post_close']['max_adverse']):
                self.assertGreaterEqual(z['price'],0)
                self.assertAlmostEqual(z['pips']*t['pip_size'],z['price'])
                self.assertAlmostEqual(z['r']*t['risk_price'],z['price'])
            for z in t['post_close']['checkpoints'].values():
                if z['state']=='fresh_asof_quote':
                    self.assertLessEqual(z['quote_age_seconds'],6)
                    sign=1 if t['side']=='buy'else -1
                    self.assertAlmostEqual(z['movement']['price'],sign*(z['executable_side_price']-t['exit_fill']))
                else:self.assertIsNone(z['movement'])
        tree=ast.parse((P/'analyse.py').read_text());scope={}
        exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef)and x.name=='move'],type_ignores=[]),'arithmetic','exec'),scope)
        self.assertEqual(scope['move'](-1,98,100,.1,2),{'price':2,'pips':20,'r':1})
        self.assertEqual(scope['move'](1,98,100,.1,2),{'price':-2,'pips':-20,'r':-1})

    def test_trigger_outcomes_and_causal_intents(self):
        joins=d['telemetry']['joins']
        self.assertEqual(len(joins),len({x['consumed_id']for x in joins}))
        self.assertEqual(len(joins),len({x['outcome_id']for x in joins}))
        for x in joins:
            self.assertLessEqual(micros(x['consumed_at']),micros(x['outcome_at']))
            if x['persisted_intent_at_outcome']:
                self.assertLessEqual(micros(x['persisted_intent_at_outcome']['created_at']),micros(x['outcome_at']))
        self.assertEqual(d['telemetry']['entries_dispatched'],sum(START<=micros(t['entry_at'])<END for t in d['ledger']if not t['prior_partial_followup']))
        self.assertEqual(len(joins),d['telemetry']['persisted_opening_intents']+d['telemetry']['pre_intent_refusals'])

    def test_gold_reopen_and_account_ownership(self):
        g=d['gold_reopen']
        self.assertFalse(g['post229_continuous_10s_retry_loop_observed'])
        for x in g['positions']:
            self.assertGreaterEqual(micros(x['send_at']),micros('2026-11-16T07:01:00+08:00'))
            self.assertLess(micros(x['send_at']),micros(x['broker_execution_at']))
            self.assertLessEqual(micros(x['broker_execution_at']),micros(x['response_received_at']))
            self.assertFalse(x['preopen_0700_0701_close_attempts'])
            self.assertGreater(x['minimum_gap_between_post229_rejections_seconds'],20)
        self.assertEqual(round(sum(x['net_usd']for x in g['positions']),2),g['gold_net_usd'])
        live=next(x for x in d['accounts']if x['account_id']==43002148)
        self.assertEqual(d['human_protection']['all_live_recorded_bot_intents_in_window'],0)
        self.assertEqual(live['current_gates']['XAUUSD']['code'],'yield_to_human_position_or_order')
        self.assertEqual(live['current_gates']['XAGUSD']['code'],'pair_risk_reservation_active')
        self.assertTrue(all(x['connected']and not x['paused']for x in d['accounts']))

    def test_openings_and_readiness_denominators(self):
        slots=d['opening_audit'];self.assertEqual(len(slots),len({(x['account_id'],x['symbol'])for x in slots}))
        core=[x for x in slots if x['symbol']!='SpotBrent'];self.assertEqual(len(core),20)
        self.assertEqual(Counter(x['verification']for x in core),{'exact_quote_receipt':18,'human_locked':2})
        self.assertTrue(all(0<=x['quote_delay_seconds']<=15 for x in slots))
        self.assertEqual(len(d['crypto_preparations']),8)
        self.assertTrue(all(x['all_marks_ready']for x in d['crypto_preparations']))
        br=d['brent_calendar_and_preparation'];self.assertFalse(br['new_0900_opening'])
        self.assertTrue(all(x['base_ready']and 'Ok'in x['mark_120_for_0900']for x in br['preparations']))
        self.assertTrue(all(x['missing_marks']for x in br['preparations']))

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main(verbosity=2)
